issues.where: night side, lower right of disc (crops C, E, H, I, Q)
issues.what: the dark-side cloud texture goes smeary and painted, with soft swirled strokes and no real cloud structure; it reads as an airbrushed shade over the image, not clouds in shadow
issues.fix: keep the same cloud detail across the terminator and darken it with lighting, rather than blurring or painting it over

issues.where: night side and lower limb (crops C, E, G, I, V)
issues.what: same smeared, muddy brush texture on the dark hemisphere; the near-limb bands look stretched and swirled, and detail is soft at native size
issues.fix: carry high-frequency cloud detail into the shadowed side and limit the stretching near the limb

issues.where: lit left limb (crops B, D, K, P)
issues.what: the bright limb blows out to a flat cream band with no texture and a thick glow round it; it looks plastic and haloed
issues.fix: pull back the highlight and the limb brightening so cloud detail survives to the edge, and narrow the atmospheric glow

issues.where: lit left limb (crops B, D, K, U)
issues.what: a broad, overexposed, featureless limb with a heavy halo against the sky
issues.fix: reduce the exposure at the limb and soften the halo falloff

issues.where: dark sky corners (crops J, T, W)
issues.what: a faint square block pattern or grid is visible in the near-black sky, like compression or tiling
issues.fix: dither the dark background, or export without block compression

issues.what: the same faint block or grid pattern in the near-black areas
issues.fix: dither the dark background and avoid compressing the sky

issues.where: feathered cloud streaks, centre of disc (crops A, P)
issues.what: the fine streaks look brushed and repetitive, more like painting than fluid flow
issues.fix: add varied, turbulent small-scale structure so the strokes don't repeat

issues.where: upper-center polar crown (crop B in image-14.png, crop K in image-15.png)
issues.what: fibrous cloud ridges converge sharply into a V-shaped polar pinch vertex, giving away spherical UV mapping
issues.fix: use a seamless cube-map or triplanar spherical projection and blend cloud structures smoothly across the pole without radial pinching

issues.where: shadowed lower-left and bottom limb (crops D, H, I in image-14.png; crops O, P in image-15.png)
issues.what: a bright tan rim line separated from the dark interior by a dark trough creates an unnatural doubled-edge halo all along the unlit night-side limb
issues.fix: remove the uniform 360-degree rim outline on the shadowed side and attenuate atmospheric scattering smoothly to darkness past the terminator

issues.where: lower and lower-right grazing limb below the spiral vortex (crops A, I in image-14.png; crops P, Q in image-15.png)
issues.what: cloud bands become blurry, smeared, and concentrically stretched compared to the crisp high-relief ridges on the upper disc
issues.fix: preserve consistent multi-scale cloud detail and proper foreshortening out to the limb without texture stretching or localized blur

issues.where: sky immediately above the left atmospheric limb (crop H in image-10.png, crop J in image-11.png)
issues.what: three evenly spaced vertical double-dot pixel artifacts repeat in a row along the top of the limb glow, and bright stars sit directly on the dense limb edge
issues.fix: remove the repeated double-dot artifacts in the sky layer and properly occlude background stars behind the optically thick atmospheric limb

issues.where: bottom foreground cloud deck (crop I in image-10.png; crops T, V, W, X in image-12.png)
issues.what: near-field clouds along the lower frame edge lose fine vapor texture and look soft and directionally smeared
issues.fix: render foreground cloud tops with crisp native-resolution detail matching the mid-ground cloud towers
